summary: Iteration 22 - Collaborator RBAC isolation verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 15/15 PASS covering: (1) collaborator GET /api/companies returns exactly 1 assigned company with NO 'default' leak, (2) GET /api/companies/active returns the assigned company for collab (200), (3) all 3 audit PDF endpoints return 403 for collab (role check fires first) while admin passes role gate, (4) POST /api/incidents succeeds for collab (200), (5) GET /api/rbac/permissions returns can_view_audits/documents/hazards/training/reports/implementation/download_reports = False and can_report_incidents = True, (6) PUT /api/users/{id}/company strictly REPLACES company_ids for non-admin users, (7) POST /api/auth/create-user with role=collaborator and no company_id returns 400, and with company_id stores exactly [company_id], (8) POST /api/users/create-demo happy path stores strict company_ids=[cid]. Startup migration ran: backend log shows 'Migration: removed default company_id leak from 10 users'. Frontend Playwright verified: (a) collab login -> /dashboard, (b) sidebar shows ONLY 'Dashboard' and 'Incidentes' (all 10 forbidden modules: Implementacion, Documentos, Matriz IPER, Capacitacion, Auditorias, Reportes, Empresas, Usuarios, Alertas, Consolidado are hidden), (c) top company dropdown shows 'Empresa Colab Demo' (no 'Mi Empresa' anywhere in DOM), (d) navigating to /audits renders 'Auditorias SG-SST' page without crash and NO 'Acta Apertura' / 'Acta Cierre' / 'Informe PDF' / 'Descargar' labels on page, (e) /incidents page shows 'Reportar Incidente' button that opens a dialog with Tipo/Severidad/Fecha/Ubicacion/Descripcion/Acciones fields, (f) 2 collab-created incidents (TEST_RBAC Colaborador reportando incidente) appear in the list proving backend POST /api/incidents works through the UI/API layer. Admin regression: admin login still sees all companies via GET /api/companies and admin permissions flags are True for write/audit/all_companies/download_reports.

context_for_next_testing_agent: RBAC collaborator isolation is fully working as of iteration 22. All 3 reported bugs fixed: (1) collab sees only assigned company, (2) collab cannot download PDFs (403), (3) collab sidebar restricted to Dashboard + Incidentes. Sidebar filter is driven by permission flags exposed via AuthContext from /api/rbac/permissions; Layout.js baseNav filters by can_view_* flags. If adding new nav items, add a matching can_view_<feature> flag on backend permissions endpoint and filter in Layout.js.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of original bugs was get_active_company auto-creating a 'default' company for any user without company_id (including collaborators), and list_companies merging company_ids verbatim which let the 'default' leak show alongside the real assigned company. Fix: list_companies now strips 'default' for non-admin/non-owner; get_active_company only auto-creates 'default' for admin/owner and returns 403 otherwise; assign_user_company uses $set replace for non-admin; startup migration scrubs pre-existing 'default' leaks. PDF endpoints already used require_role so 403 is correctly returned before DB lookup.
